Provisional design of an original lanky 15-year-old boy from a fishing village in Fortaleza, 1932, apprentice raft fisherman, dark brown skin, short tightly coiled afro hair, long limbs, long neck, big hands and big bare feet, mature teenage face. Wide woven straw hat. Open faded pinkish brown cotton shirt with rolled sleeves; warm reddish-brown mangrove-dyed trousers (#8A5A3C) rolled up to the shin, with small neatly sewn patches; thin rope tied at the waist, no belt buckle; barefoot. A dark indigo cloth tied in a knot around the LEFT upper arm, above the elbow, visible in every view, nowhere else; no cloth on the shoulders or back. In the front and side views he holds a small palm-sized pocket notebook in his right hand; in the back view his hands are empty.
